name: HQ menu and page frame: side menu, phone bottom bar, page router, signed-in email, sign out, sign-in redirect
Needs you: one list of what waits (leads, feedback, new gyms, payments), with a count on the menu and in the tab title, refreshed every minute
Needs you alerts: a short sound and a browser pop-up when something new arrives while HQ is open
switch: browser notification permission (asked by the Turn on alerts button)

name: Read-log warning line on top of every page (the read log is off, failing, or its key is missing)
All gyms: list of every gym with search, filter, sort, summary tiles, and a tick to show test and demo gyms
switch: plansReady (trial tiles, trial column, trial filters and sort show only after database update 0030)

name: Gyms with branches: each gym business with its branches, member counts and the extra-branch price
Export the shown gyms as a CSV file (written to the log first; has owners' names and mobiles)
Make a gym by hand (also from a lead) and get the owner's one-time sign-in code with a WhatsApp message to copy
One gym's page: counts (members, check-ins, takings, cancelled receipts, orders, staff, wrong codes), owner to call, delete-request notice, what HQ did here
Change a gym's free trial end date (with a reason, up to the cap)
Set a gym's plan by hand after a payment (Starter or Pro, monthly, yearly or lifetime, paid until), or take the plan off
Gym status: mark a new gym as checked, pause a gym (read-only), un-pause it
Owner lost their sign-in: make a new one-time sign-in code after calling the gym
Sign a gym out everywhere (every phone and computer at once)
AI column matching: see a gym's 30-day AI use and cost, set its reads-a-day limit or put it back to normal
switch: per-gym AI reads-a-day limit (0 = off for this gym)

name: AI Assistant credits: see a gym's balance, this month's use and cost, add a paid pack or free credits, or take free credits back
switch: aiCredits ready (shows AI_NOT_READY words until the credits database update 0071 is applied)

name: AI Assistant daily limit: set a gym's AI requests and spoken minutes a day, or put it back to normal
switch: assistAllowance ready (web database update 0015); per-gym limit 0 = AI Assistant off for this gym

name: Gym web page: switch one gym's public web page off or on
switch: per-gym pageOn; all-gym pagesLive (the panel's GYM_PAGES)

name: Support access: open read-only access to a gym in an emergency (reason, 15 to 60 minutes), look at its records while open, close it
switch: support access open (supportUntil in the future; opened by the gym or by HQ)

name: Sign-in history of a gym (times only; names, devices and addresses only while support access is open)
switch: support access open (adds names, devices, addresses)

name: System page: gym server storage used, totals, AI reads and cost this month, member app downloads per version, Cloudflare free-limit check
Not a feature: two placeholder cards on System (Errors and outages; Which app version members use) that only say not connected yet
Feedback inbox: read what members and gyms sent with the AI's answer, filter (needs reply, bug, idea ...), set a status and a private note
Reply to feedback: the person reads it in the app's Help and feedback, and gets a phone pop-up when their app can take one
switch: only for messages sent from the help box (covered); can_push decides the pop-up

name: English helper: rewrite a reply draft with AI before sending, with Undo and this month's cost
switch: Gemini key on the HQ server (keyOn)

name: Leads: gyms that asked for a demo on the website, with status (new, called, demo, won, lost), a note, a call link and Make a gym for this lead
Delete requests: write down a request (from the admin app or another way), tick the steps (called, reminded, member erased), see days left of 30, cancel
Delete a gym for ever (type the gym code; every record and picture erased)
Messages: send one message to every gym's admin app bell (title, words, optional button), see sent ones, take one back
switch: MSG_NOT_READY (page shows only a notice until the messages database update is applied)

name: Payments to MettleUp: see what gym owners say they paid (UPI or bank), confirm it (plan moves on) or mark not confirmed with a reason the owner reads
switch: PAY_NOT_READY (page shows only a notice until database update 0060 is applied)

name: Online payments to check: money a gym paid online that did not become a plan; mark refunded or added by hand with a note
switch: CHECKS_NOT_READY (card removed while online buying is off or database update 0064 is not applied)

name: Your payment details: set the UPI ID and bank account that gym owners see on Pay MettleUp
switch: none (not set = owners see Payment is not available yet)

name: Log: everything done in HQ and every look at a gym, 100 lines at a time with Show older
Install HQ on the phone (Install app button, iPhone hint), the phone More menu sheet, and the plain You're offline page
